Be strict and independent - do NOT assume the audited answer is correct.\n\nCONTEXT. The Andes hybrid RISC-V simulator hands off architectural state from QEMU (functional) to vsim (cycle-accurate) across a region of interest (ROI). Every CSR in the AndeStar V5 SPA is classified into THREE buckets, for the supported envelope: bare-metal, single-hart, M-mode or M+U-mode, trap-free ROI.\n\nTHE THREE BUCKETS:\n- done   : the handoff transports it AND the current engine (ax45mpv_premium) implements it, so it is restored into vsim now.\n- blocked: it is IN SCOPE (M-mode state, or U-mode state since we support M+U) and we WANT to transport it, but premium's config lacks the needed mode/extension, so it can't be exercised yet (would work on a different engine). Name what is missing.\n- na     : we do NOT transport it, by design. Either (a) OUTSIDE the envelope: needs S-mode or Hypervisor - INCLUDING M-mode registers whose function requires S-mode (medeleg, mideleg, mcountermask_s, mslideleg) and S paging (satp); or (b) NOT transportable state: read-only (MRO/URO) config/info, OR MRW-but-WARL-fixed/hardwired (misa pinned to ISA, tdata3 always-0, tinfo read-only info), RV32-only high-half shadow on this RV64 core, side-effecting/instruction-like (pushmcause/pushmepc/pushmxstatus, mnxti, mscratchcsw/mscratchcswl, mcctlcommand, mintsel_jal, wfe, txevt, ucctlcommand), indirect-access mechanism (miselect/mireg*), debug-mode-internal (dcsr/dpc/dscratch0/dscratch1/dexc2dbg/ddcause), write-1-clear/HW-driven status (mcounterovf), N-extension user trap state (ustatus/uie/utvec/uscratch/uepc/ucause/utval/uip), or a trap-cause latch (udcause).\n\nGROUND TRUTH - engine ax45mpv_premium (M-only, priv=1, RV64GCV):\nIMPLEMENTS (handoff transports + gate ON) these custom/Andes/ext CSRs:\n  mxstatus, mclk_ctl, milmb, mdlmb, mcountermask_m, uitb, jvt, pmacfg0, pmacfg2, pmaaddr0..3,\n  mcountinhibit, mhpmcounter3, mhpmcounter4, mhpmcounter5, mhpmcounter6,\n  mhpmevent3, mhpmevent4, mhpmevent5, mhpmevent6, mcounterinten, mdcause,\n  tselect, tdata1, tdata2, tcontrol, mcontext\nALSO always transports this standard M-mode state: mstatus, mie, mtvec, mepc, mcause, mtval, mscratch, mip, mcycle, minstret, fcsr (frm/fflags), pmpcfg0..15, pmpaddr0..63 (M-mode pass-through), mcache_ctl, mmisc_ctl.\nLACKS (feature OFF, so those CSRs are gated off / absent on premium):\n  - privilege: U-mode, S-mode, Hypervisor (priv=1)\n  - Andes features: POWERBRAKE (-> mpft_ctl), ECC (-> mecc_code), STACKSAFE (-> mhsp_ctl, msp_bound, msp_base), DSP (-> ucode)\n  - extensions: CLIC (-> mtvt, mintthresh, mcirq_entry/mirq_entry), Smrnmi/resumable-NMI (-> mnscratch, mnepc, mncause, mnstatus, mnvec, mrnxvec), Smstateen (-> mstateen0..3), ePMP/Smepmp (-> mseccfg), CCTLCSR (-> mcctlbeginaddr, mcctldata), PPI (-> mppib), FIO (-> mfiob), exception save-levels EXCSLVL (-> msavestatus, msaveepc1/2, msavecause1/2, msavedcause1/2), and mcounterwen needs U-mode.\n\nDECISION ORDER per CSR (apply first match):\n1. Needs S-mode/Hypervisor (incl. medeleg, mideleg, mcountermask_s, mslideleg, satp) -> na.\n2. Read-only/WARL-fixed/hardwired (MRO/URO config & info; misa, tdata3, tinfo) -> na.\n3. RV32-only high-half (names ending h: mcycleh, minstreth, mhpmcounter*h, mhpmevent*h, menvcfgh, mseccfgh, mstateen*h, mcache_ctl2, and odd-numbered RV32 pmacfg1/3/5/.../11) -> na.\n4. Side-effecting/instruction-like -> na (list above).\n5. Indirect-access (miselect/mireg*) -> na.\n6. Debug-mode-internal -> na.\n7. W1C/HW-driven status (mcounterovf) -> na. N-ext user trap CSRs -> na. udcause -> na.\n8. Otherwise transportable M/U state:\n   - premium IMPLEMENTS it (ground truth) -> done.\n   - premium LACKS the mode/extension -> blocked (name what is missing: \"U-mode\", \"POWERBRAKE\", \"ECC\", \"STACKSAFE\", \"DSP\", \"CLIC\", \"Smrnmi\", \"Smstateen\", \"ePMP\", \"CCTL\", \"PPI\", \"FIO\", \"exception save-levels\").\n\nINPUT FILES (read both):\n  /home/nick/work/andesim/tests/andes_csr/csr_inventory.csv   (addr,name,priv,mode,section - the spec list, 232 data rows)\n  /tmp/claude-1002/-home-nick-work-andesim/9fb5c597-ba1e-4046-8ada-d69e84b4f335/scratchpad/mine.csv   (addr,name,status,reason - the classification UNDER AUDIT)\n\nSome names are ranges (e.g. mhpmcounter3~6) or aliases (mcontrol/tdata1 == tdata1; mcirq_entry == mirq_entry; ﬂags == fflags).
